review: NEEDS OWNER REVIEW. Section numbers and titles were checked on 2026-11-20 (see checked_against); which pointers go with which issue, and the pre-AIA ranges whose titles were not confirmed, have not been reviewed by a practitioner.
scope: Pointers only: the name of a section of the MPEP, 35 USC or 37 CFR that a practitioner may want to read for an issue. No case law, no summary of what a provision requires, no view on how it applies. Section numbers and titles can change between MPEP editions and revisions: confirm each against the edition in force before relying on it (see checked_against).
aia_split: Applications with an effective filing date on or after 2013-03-16 are examined under the AIA versions of 35 USC 102 and 103; earlier ones under the pre-AIA versions. The action itself says which applies; the tool reads that statement from the text and, when it cannot, lists both sets.
